results.title: Nyamira Hospital performs first total hip replacement surgeries
results.description: The hospital successfully conducted two total hip replacement procedures in a carefully planned three-hour operation led by a multidisciplinary team of specialists.

results.title: ‘No dietary requirements (but I do hate pap)’
results.description: Whatever happened to Banting? How prevalent is vegetarianism, really? Is gluten-free as commonplace as we might think? Two decades of feeding the Kalahari’s visitors, and what their forms told us.
